items.markdown:
![Editable Competitor Analysis Comparison Chart Template - Venngage](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081545-2633-0066-0000-c918e5edddc3:12)
You can build a clear framework using the [HubSpot Competitive Analysis Template](https://www.hubspot.com/resources/templates/competitive-analysis) or a visual structure from [Canva Competitor Analysis Guide](https://www.canva.com/docs/competitor-analysis/) to compare your business against rivals.

### Essential Sections of a Competitor Analysis Template

- **Company Profile & Overview** 
	- Competitor name, headquarters location, and website
	- Years in business, team size, and funding or revenue details
	- Target market and ideal customer profile (ICP)
- **Product & Feature Matrix** 
	- Core products, service lines, and key features
	- Unique value proposition (UVP) and key differentiators
	- Product quality, usability gaps, and customer complaints
- **Pricing & Monetization Strategy** 
	- Base prices, tiers, and packaging
	- Discounts, free trials, and promotional frequency
- **Marketing & Go-To-Market (GTM)** 
	- Primary acquisition channels (SEO, PPC, social media, content)
	- Brand messaging, taglines, and public positioning
- **SWOT Analysis** 
	- **Strengths:** What the competitor does better than anyone else
	- **Weaknesses:** Where they fall short or receive bad reviews
	- **Opportunities:** Market gaps you can exploit
	- **Threats:** External risks or aggressive moves by the rival

If you'd like, let me know:

- Your **industry or product type** 
- Whether you need to analyze **direct vs. indirect** competitors

I can help tailor the exact metrics or matrix rows for your grid.
